description: Make the link your human opens to get a spare key to your line. If you ever lose your line's key, their spare key brings the same number back; without one, a lost key is a lost number. The link holds no secret, so it's safe to show them; it works once, within 15 minutes. The spare key itself is shown only to your human, on the page: you never see it, and never ask for it. Only for a line you hold by your own key. Up to three links a day.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: spare_key
title: Make a spare key link
